name: oxform-root
description: Oxform is a lean and flexible framework-agnostic form library.
author: Frantss <frantss.bongiovanni@gmail.com>

scripts.test: vp run oxform-core#test && vp run oxform-react#test && vp run example-oxform-react#test && vp run oxform-solid#test && vp run oxform-solid#test:ssr && vp run example-oxform-solid#test && vp run example-oxform-solid-v2#test
scripts.check:package: vp run oxform-core#check:package && vp run oxform-react#check:package && vp run oxform-solid#check:package
scripts.check: vp lint --type-aware && vp fmt --check && vp run -r check:types
scripts.check:all: vp run -w check && vp run -w check:package
scripts.prepublish: vp run -w build && vp run -w check:all
